name: solidping
description: Read and manage uptime checks, incidents, status pages and maintenance windows on a SolidPing instance.
long_description: Connects an MCP client to a SolidPing instance (self-hosted or solidping.io). List and create checks, read results and incidents, manage maintenance windows and status pages. Needs the instance URL and a Personal Access Token. The extension downloads the matching sp release binary on first start and verifies its SHA-256 against a value pinned in this bundle.

url.title: SolidPing URL
url.description: Base URL of your SolidPing instance, for example https://solidping.io or http://localhost:4000.

token.title: Personal Access Token
token.description: A SolidPing Personal Access Token. Create one in the dashboard. It is passed to the sp binary through the environment and never written to disk.
